# mcrl audit

[Command reference](README.md)

List forgotten or stale settings.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl audit [flags]

List settings that have likely been forgotten: muted monitors, ended
downtimes, hosts that stopped sending metrics, unused channels, users
without two-factor authentication, and so on. Nothing is changed.

Each finding is {"kind", "severity", "resource": {"type", "id", "name"},
"message", "details"}. Use --check to run some checks only, and --fail-on
to exit with code 8 when a finding at or above a severity is found (for CI
and cron).

Checks:
  muted-monitor              warning  monitors that are muted
  ended-downtime             info     downtimes that will never be in effect again
  dangling-scope             warning  monitor and downtime scopes naming a service, role or monitor that does not exist
  host-inactive              info     standby, maintenance or poweroff hosts with no metric for --older-than
  host-stale-metrics         warning  working hosts whose agent metrics stopped more than --older-than ago
  host-without-role          info     hosts with no role
  alert-on-retired-host      warning  open alerts of retired hosts
  unused-service             info     services with no host and no service metric
  unused-role                info     roles with no host
  unused-channel             info     notification channels in no notification group
  empty-notification-group   warning  notification groups with no channel and no child group
  user-without-mfa           warning  users who have not enabled two-factor authentication
  expired-invitation         info     invitations past their expiry

Hosts are judged by the newest of loadavg5, cpu.user.percentage, memory.used
(GET /tsdb/latest). For hosts that have none of them, such as hosts
registered through the API only, host-stale-metrics does not apply and
host-inactive uses the registration time instead.

API: GET /api/v0/monitors, GET /api/v0/downtimes, GET /api/v0/services, GET /api/v0/hosts, GET /api/v0/tsdb/latest, GET /api/v0/alerts, GET /api/v0/hosts/<id>, GET /api/v0/services/<name>/metric-names, GET /api/v0/channels, GET /api/v0/notification-groups, GET /api/v0/users, GET /api/v0/invitations
API key permission: Read

Examples:
  mcrl audit
  mcrl audit --check muted-monitor --check ended-downtime
  mcrl audit --older-than 7d -o jsonl --jq 'select(.severity == "warning") | .message'
  mcrl audit --fail-on warning > audit.json   # exit code 8 when a warning is found

Flags:
      --check strings       run only this check (repeatable or comma-separated)
      --fail-on string      exit with code 8 if a finding of this severity or higher is found: info or warning
      --older-than string   how long without metrics makes a host stale or inactive (default "30d")
```
